subject: A question about the variable name generate by part2 result

messages.author: e246b463ba88b8d6
messages.subject: A question about the variable name generate by part2 result
parts:
Hi all,

I get two variables from part 2 results that I am not sure if my interpretation for them is correct. I wonder if anyone can help me with it. The first variable is "p95.83333_ENMO_mg_0.24hr" and my current interpretation for it is the 95.83333th percentile of metric value ENMO  between 0 to 24 hours. And the second variable is "X.36.201._ENMO_mg_0.24hr" and my interpretation for it is the average metric value ENMO  for ENMO metric threshold of 36 to 201 mg between 0 to 24 hours. The 36 and 201 is the light and moderate acceleration threshold. Can anyone help me to confirm if the interpretation is correct? Thank you very much.

Sincerely,
Julia

The first variable is "p95.83333_ENMO_mg_0.24hr" and my current interpretation for it is the 95.83333th percentile of metric value ENMO  between 0 to 24 hours.

And the second variable is "X.36.201._ENMO_mg_0.24hr" and my interpretation for it is the average metric value ENMO  for ENMO metric threshold of 36 to 201 mg between 0 to 24 hours. The 36 and 201 is the light and moderate acceleration threshold.

>> LOOKS CORRECT, AND THIS RELATES TO ARGUMENT "ilevels". NOTE THATVARIABLE NAME "X.36.201._ENMO_mg_0.24hr" IS NOT HOW GGIR ORIGINALLY DERIVES IT. YOUR MACHINE PROBABLY CONVERTED IT FROM "[36, 201]_ENMO_mg_0.24h"
